def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    colors=set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    candidates=[]
    for color in colors:
        score=sum(all(v==color for v in row) for row in grid)+sum(all(grid[r][c]==color for r in range(h)) for c in range(w))
        candidates.append((score,color))
    divider=max(candidates)[1]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        if all(v==divider for v in grid[r]): out[r]=[2]*w
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c]==divider for r in range(h)):
            for r in range(h): out[r][c]=2
    return out
PY
